llms.note: Aimed at testers, developers and QA who need to reproduce a bad connection on purpose. Impairment can be pointed at one process, PID, address or port, so the rest of the machine keeps working. Runs are repeatable with a seed, and the command line reports through exit codes and NDJSON, so a pipeline can use it. Not available for Linux or macOS.
llms.summary: Bean Network Tester is a free, open source (GNU GPL v3) Windows tool that deliberately degrades the network for one application: added latency and jitter, packet loss, corruption and duplication, download and upload speed limits, connection resets, link outages, port and address blocking, and LAN-only mode. It has a window and a command line in the same executable. Requires Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, and administrator rights, because traffic is captured by the WinDivert driver. It sends no data anywhere.
